summary: Evaluate (Alg 2 l.11) throws std::overflow_error('integer length overflow') when the relaxation value emitted(tail) + l of a NON-shortest walk reaches the uint64 sentinel while the head has no offer yet: edges 0 -1- 1, 1 -(2^64 - 2)- 2, 1 -1- 3, 3 -1- 2, source 0. Vertex 1 emits at 1 and the arc 1 -> 2 gives 2^64 - 1; vertex 2 later gets 3 via vertex 3. Every distance fits.

found_by.test: review of the overflow class of 20261127-evaluate-mass-overflow (P3-EVAL-ARITH-FIX), no random search

expected: the exact distances: an overflowing relaxation is skipped (Bellman-Ford rule of docs/design/numerics.md §6); std::overflow_error only if a state that received such an offer never emits
